scope: Corollary 17.3 (Quantitative midpoint bound for the Gamma family) of the manuscript “Strict convexity and differentiability of the planar exponential first-passage limit shape” (preprints/Strict-convexity-and-differentiability-of-the-planar-exponential-first-passage-limit-shape-September-24-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 212 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 7cc30ddbfd4419f1), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 91. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For every κ > 0 there is Cκ < ∞ such that, for every λ > 0 and all a, b, z ∈ Z2 with D = min{∥a − z∥1, ∥b − z∥1} ≥ 1, P z ∈ Γκ,λ(a, b)  ≤ Cκ log2 (D + 2) D1/16 , where Γκ,λ denotes the unique geodesic for iid Gamma(κ, λ) edge weights.
